probes.name: runtime-mutation-controls
probes.command: node -e 'const fs=require('"'"'fs'"'"'),p=require('"'"'path'"'"'),os=require('"'"'os'"'"'),cp=require('"'"'child_process'"'"'),a=require('"'"'assert/strict'"'"');const root=process.cwd(),tmp=fs.mkdtempSync(p.join(os.tmpdir(),'"'"'isswf-mut-'"'"'));try{const names=['"'"'.claude-plugin/plugin.json'"'"','"'"'skills/isswf-coordinator/SKILL.md'"'"','"'"'.agents/skills/isswf-coordinator/SKILL.md'"'"','"'"'.agents/hosts/claude-code.md'"'"','"'"'docs/host-portability.md'"'"','"'"'package.json'"'"','"'"'tools/isswf-job.mjs'"'"','"'"'tools/pi-worker-task.mjs'"'"',...fs.readdirSync('"'"'agents'"'"').map(n=>'"'"'agents/'"'"'+n)];for(const n of names){fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(p.join(tmp,n)),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(p.join(root,n),p.join(tmp,n));}const run=()=>cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[p.join(root,'"'"'tests/host-portability.mjs'"'"'),tmp],{encoding:'"'"'utf8'"'"'});a.equal(run().status,0);for(const n of ['"'"'tools/isswf-job.mjs'"'"','"'"'tools/pi-worker-task.mjs'"'"']){const f=p.join(tmp,n),b=fs.readFileSync(f);fs.appendFileSync(f,'"'"'\n// mutation probe\n'"'"');const r=run();a.equal(r.status,1);a.ok(r.stderr.includes('"'"'Pi runtime changed: '"'"'+n));fs.writeFileSync(f,b);console.log('"'"'DETECTED '"'"'+n);}a.equal(run().status,0);console.log('"'"'POSITIVE CONTROL PASS'"'"');}finally{fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true});}'
